release-console.description: The Release Console's own keys (owner, 2026-11-20: 'Yes, all recommended'). Stored once, in the dev project. Read by apps/release-console-api/src only; never rendered into the shop's files or a release. Each read/change pair is complete when either key is filled: the console reads with the change key when there is no read key.

github-actions.description: Keys only GitHub Actions workflows use, kept here as the master copy for safe keeping (owner, 2026-11-20). The workflow reads its repository secret of the same name; copy a changed value to GitHub's repository secrets too. Read by .github/workflows only; never rendered into the shop's files or a release.
